d: CENI-GWEXER infiNET EX® Network and ER Wireless Gateway - International Version

specs.label: RF Transceiver
specs.value: infiNET EX & ER 2-way RF, 2.4 GHz ISM Channels 11-26 (2400 to 2483.5 MHz), default channel 15; IEEE 802.15.4 compliant

specs.label: infiNET EX Range (typical)
specs.value: 150 ft (46 m) indoor, 250 ft (76 m) outdoor, to nearest mesh network device(s); subject to site-specific conditions and individual device capabilities

specs.label: ER Range (typical)
specs.value: 100 to 200 ft (33 to 66 m) maximum indoor, 1000 ft (305 m) outdoor, subject to site-specific conditions

specs.label: ER Roaming
specs.value: Supports roaming amongst up to 8 gateways

specs.label: Ethernet
specs.value: 10/100 Mbps, auto-switching, auto-negotiating, auto-discovery, full/half duplex, DHCP, IEEE 802.3at Type 1 compliant

specs.label: Power over Ethernet
specs.value: IEEE 802.3at Type 1 (802.3af compatible) Class 1 (3.84 W) PoE Powered Device; 100-250 Volts AC, 50/60 Hz PoE Injector, model PWE-4803RU included with models CEN-GWEXER-PWE & CENI-GWEXER-PWE

specs.label: Power Pack
specs.value: 0.75 Amps (minimum) @ 24 Volts DC; 100-240 Volts AC, 50/60 Hz power pack, model PW-2407WU sold separately

specs.label: Construction enclosure
specs.value: IFE small form factor, black and blue plastic

specs.label: Construction mounting
specs.value: Freestanding, stackable, surface mount, or 35 mm DIN EN 60715 rail mount; occupies 8 DIN module spaces (144 mm); surface/DIN rail mounting bracket included, optional rack mount and pole mount kits sold separately

specs.label: Height
specs.value: 1.35 in (35 mm); 1.77 in (45 mm) with bracket
